column1: # The player confirmed the community dynamic-FPS patch removes movement shaking.
# Handheld mode reaches 60 FPS in lighter scenes; heavier gameplay still varies.
# Disabling alpha coverage on the paving-stone vertex shader removes fixed black
# road seams (player A/B confirmation); the other render states stay unchanged.
# Startup reports one draw without a usable render target. Bluetooth peers
# (including Pokemon GO connectivity) are unavailable; bt/btm:u expose none.
